---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m8p5t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Courses, Students, Total
VARIABLES coarse, fine, log, pool

None == "none"
Instances == {"A", "B"}
Range(s) == {s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s}

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Instances \cup {None}
    /\ fine \in [Courses -> Instances \cup {None}]
    /\ log \in Seq(Students)
    /\ pool \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ fine = [k \in Courses |-> None]
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ pool = Total

AcquireCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ coarse' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, log, pool>>

ReleaseCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ coarse' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, log, pool>>

AcquireFine(i, k) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[k] = None
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![k] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, log, pool>>

Enroll(i, k, s) ==
    /\ fine[k] = i
    /\ pool >= 1
    /\ s \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, s)
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(i, k) ==
    /\ fine[k] = i
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![k] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, log, pool>>

Refill ==
    /\ pool < Total
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, log>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : ReleaseCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, k \in Courses : AcquireFine(i, k)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, k \in Courses, s \in Students : Enroll(i, k, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, k \in Courses : ReleaseFine(i, k)
    \/ Refill

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<coarse, fine, log, pool>>

NoDoubleEnroll == \A a, b \in DOMAIN log : log[a] = log[b] => a = b
=============================================================================
nl:
A university course-registration system runs two independent registrar instances,
A and B, that share one pool of course seats. Enrollment is protected by a
two-level hierarchical lock: a single coarse registrar lock, then a fine per-course
lock. An instance first acquires the coarse lock, then uses it to acquire the fine
lock on a specific course. Enrolling a student is irreversible: an instance
holding a course's fine lock may enroll a student, consuming one seat from the
shared pool and appending the student to the enrollment log, but only if that
student has not already been enrolled. The coarse and fine locks are released when
done, and the shared seat pool can be refilled up to its total.

Actions: acquire the coarse lock, release the coarse lock, acquire a fine course
lock, enroll a student under a held fine lock, release a fine lock, and refill the
shared seat pool.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No student ever appears more than once in the enrollment log, so
the irreversible enrollment of any given student happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m6p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Accounts, Operators, MaxTTL
VARIABLES ttl, holder, armed, log

None == "none"
Range(s) == {s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s}

TypeOK ==
    /\ ttl \in [Accounts -> 0..MaxTTL]
    /\ holder \in [Accounts -> Operators \cup {None}]
    /\ armed \in [Accounts -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ log \in Seq(Accounts)

Init ==
    /\ ttl = [a \in Accounts |-> 0]
    /\ holder = [a \in Accounts |-> None]
    /\ armed = [a \in Accounts |-> FALSE]
    /\ log = << >>

Lease(o, a) ==
    /\ holder[a] = None
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![a] = o]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![a] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, log>>

Countdown(a) ==
    /\ ttl[a] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![a] = ttl[a] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, armed, log>>

Lapse(a) ==
    /\ ttl[a] = 0
    /\ holder[a] # None
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![a] = None]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, log>>

Arm(o, a) ==
    /\ holder[a] = o
    /\ ttl[a] > 0
    /\ ~armed[a]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![a] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, holder, log>>

Settle(o, a) ==
    /\ holder[a] = o
    /\ ttl[a] > 0
    /\ armed[a]
    /\ a \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, a)
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, holder>>

AdminSettle(a) ==
    /\ a \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, a)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, holder, armed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Operators, a \in Accounts : Lease(o, a)
    \/ \E a \in Accounts : Countdown(a)
    \/ \E a \in Accounts : Lapse(a)
    \/ \E o \in Operators, a \in Accounts : Arm(o, a)
    \/ \E o \in Operators, a \in Accounts : Settle(o, a)
    \/ \E a \in Accounts : AdminSettle(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<ttl, holder, armed, log>>

NoDoubleSettle == \A x, y \in DOMAIN log : log[x] = log[y] => x = y
=============================================================================
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch finalizes accounts under lease-based
ownership with expiry. An operator leases a free account, which sets the account's
lease time-to-live to its maximum. The time-to-live counts down; once it reaches
zero the lease lapses, freeing the account and clearing any armed flag. An
operator holding a live lease first arms the account, then settles it. Settling is
irreversible: an operator holding a live lease on an armed account appends it to
the settlement log, but only if that account has not already been settled;
settling clears the armed flag. A privileged admin override may settle an account
directly, bypassing the lease and arming, but it too refuses an account already in
the log.

Actions: lease a free account, count down a lease, lapse a zero-time lease, arm a
leased account, settle an armed account under a live lease, and admin-settle an
account.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No account ever appears more than once in the settlement log, so
the irreversible settlement of any given account happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m0p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxVer
VARIABLES ver, owner, snap, controlling, down

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ owner \in Controllers \cup {None}
    /\ snap \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ controlling \subseteq Controllers
    /\ down \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ owner = None
    /\ snap = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ controlling = {}
    /\ down = {}

Read(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, controlling, down>>

Bump ==
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, snap, controlling, down>>

Acquire(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ owner = None
    /\ snap[c] = ver
    /\ owner' = c
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxVer THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, controlling, down>>

Control(c) ==
    /\ owner = c
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ c \notin controlling
    /\ controlling' = controlling \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snap, down>>

Stop(c) ==
    /\ c \in controlling
    /\ controlling' = controlling \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snap, down>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ owner = c
    /\ c \notin controlling
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxVer THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, controlling, down>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ down' = down \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snap, controlling>>

Reboot(c) ==
    /\ c \in down
    /\ down' = down \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snap, controlling>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Read(c)
    \/ Bump
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Control(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Stop(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Reboot(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<ver, owner, snap, controlling, down>>

Mutex == \A c \in controlling : owner = c
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    MaxVer = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Mutex
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network lets several controllers contend for exclusive
control of a shared door lock using optimistic locking over a version number. A
running controller reads the current version into its snapshot; background
activity may bump the version. A controller acquires ownership of the door only
when the door is unowned and its snapshot still matches the current version, at
which point the version advances. Only the owning controller may enter active
control of the door, and it later stops controlling and then releases ownership,
advancing the version. Any controller can crash silently and stop taking new
steps; a crashed controller can later reboot. Even a crashed owner's control can
be stopped and its ownership released so the door does not stay stuck.

Actions: read the version, bump the version, acquire the unowned door on a fresh
snapshot, enter active control as owner, stop controlling, release ownership,
crash silently, and reboot.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every controller actively controlling the door is its current
owner, so at most one controller controls the shared door lock at any time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m2p3t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Slots, Claimants, Parts
VARIABLES alloc, holds, phase, votes, pend

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Claimants \cup {None}]
    /\ holds \in [Claimants -> Slots \cup {None}]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "commit"}
    /\ votes \in [Parts -> {"?", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ pend \in [claimant : Claimants, slot : Slots]

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ holds = [c \in Claimants |-> None]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [p \in Parts |-> "?"]
    /\ pend = [claimant |-> CHOOSE c \in Claimants : TRUE,
               slot |-> CHOOSE s \in Slots : TRUE]

Propose ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ \E c \in Claimants, s \in Slots :
         /\ holds[c] = None
         /\ alloc[s] = None
         /\ pend' = [claimant |-> c, slot |-> s]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [p \in Parts |-> "?"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, holds>>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[p] = "?"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, holds, phase, pend>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : votes[p] = "yes"
    /\ alloc[pend.slot] = None
    /\ holds[pend.claimant] = None
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![pend.slot] = pend.claimant]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![pend.claimant] = pend.slot]
    /\ phase' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, pend>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E p \in Parts : votes[p] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, holds, votes, pend>>

ReleaseSlot(c) ==
    /\ holds[c] # None
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![holds[c]] = None]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![c] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, pend>>

AdminAllocate ==
    /\ \E c \in Claimants, s \in Slots :
         /\ holds[c] = None
         /\ alloc[s] = None
         /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = c]
         /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, pend>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "commit"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, holds, votes, pend>>

Next ==
    \/ Propose
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Vote(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E c \in Claimants : ReleaseSlot(c)
    \/ AdminAllocate
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<alloc, holds, phase, votes, pend>>

NoDoubleAlloc == \A c \in Claimants : holds[c] # None => alloc[holds[c]] = c
=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns exclusive survey slots to claimant
drones, coordinating each assignment with two-phase commit across participant
nodes. The system keeps two views: which claimant each slot is allocated to, and
which slot each claimant holds. An assignment is proposed for a free claimant and
a free slot; participants then vote. The assignment commits only when every
participant votes yes and both the slot and the claimant are still free, at which
point the slot is allocated to the claimant and the claimant is recorded as
holding that slot. Any no vote aborts. A claimant may release the slot it holds,
freeing both views. A privileged admin override may allocate a free slot to a
free claimant directly without a vote.

Actions: propose an assignment, cast a vote, commit when all yes and both free,
abort on a no vote, release a held slot, admin-allocate directly, and reset after
a commit.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a claimant holds a slot, that slot is allocated to that
same claimant, so the two views stay consistent and no slot is ever double
allocated to two different claimants.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m4p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS QCap, Cap, MaxStore, Budget
VARIABLES queue, carousel, delivered, slow, arrived

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in 0..QCap
    /\ carousel \in 0..MaxStore
    /\ delivered \in 0..Budget
    /\ slow \in BOOLEAN
    /\ arrived \in 0..Budget

Init ==
    /\ queue = 0
    /\ carousel = 0
    /\ delivered = 0
    /\ slow = FALSE
    /\ arrived = 0

Arrive ==
    /\ arrived < Budget
    /\ queue < QCap
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ arrived' = arrived + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<carousel, delivered, slow>>

Route ==
    /\ ~slow
    /\ queue >= 1
    /\ carousel < Cap
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ carousel' = carousel + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<delivered, slow, arrived>>

Unload ==
    /\ carousel >= 1
    /\ carousel' = carousel - 1
    /\ delivered' = delivered + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, slow, arrived>>

GoSlow ==
    /\ ~slow
    /\ slow' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, carousel, delivered, arrived>>

Recover ==
    /\ slow
    /\ slow' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, carousel, delivered, arrived>>

Next ==
    \/ Arrive
    \/ Route
    \/ Unload
    \/ GoSlow
    \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<queue, carousel, delivered, slow, arrived>>

WithinCap == carousel <= Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    QCap = 2
    Cap = 2
    MaxStore = 4
    Budget = 4
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WithinCap
nl:
An airport baggage router feeds arriving bags through a bounded work queue with
backpressure onto a sortation carousel of bounded capacity. Bags arrive into the
queue only while the queue length is below its capacity and the day's arrival
budget is not exhausted; when the queue is full the backpressure blocks further
arrivals. The router moves a queued bag onto the carousel only while the carousel
holds fewer bags than its capacity. Bags are unloaded off the carousel and
counted as delivered. The router can be slow -- lagging but not failed -- and
while slow it routes nothing until it recovers.

Actions: a bag arrives under backpressure and budget, the router routes a queued
bag onto the carousel while under capacity, a bag is unloaded and delivered, the
router goes slow, and the router recovers.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of bags on the sortation carousel never exceeds the
carousel's bounded capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m1p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES tokenAt, epoch, seen, acting, slow

Nodes == 1..N
NextRing(t) == IF t < N THEN t + 1 ELSE 1

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Nodes
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ seen \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ acting \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ slow \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = 1
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ seen = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ acting = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ slow = {}

NoActing == \A n \in Nodes : ~acting[n]

PassToken ==
    /\ NoActing
    /\ tokenAt' = NextRing(tokenAt)
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, acting, slow>>

Observe(n) ==
    /\ tokenAt = n
    /\ n \notin slow
    /\ seen[n] # epoch
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![n] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, epoch, acting, slow>>

StartDispense(n) ==
    /\ tokenAt = n
    /\ n \notin slow
    /\ seen[n] = epoch
    /\ ~acting[n]
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, epoch, seen, slow>>

StopDispense(n) ==
    /\ acting[n]
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, epoch, seen, slow>>

MarkSlow(n) ==
    /\ n \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, epoch, seen, acting>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, epoch, seen, acting>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Observe(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : StartDispense(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : StopDispense(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : MarkSlow(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<tokenAt, epoch, seen, acting, slow>>

NoStaleAction ==
    \A n \in Nodes : acting[n] => (tokenAt = n /\ seen[n] = epoch)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser arranges its dispensing stations in a token
ring. A single circulating token, tagged with the current authority epoch, grants
the exclusive right to dispense. When no station is mid-dispense the token passes
to the next station in the ring and the authority epoch advances. Each station
caches the epoch it last observed; a station that currently holds the token and
is not slow may observe the current epoch to refresh itself. Only a station that
holds the token and has observed the current epoch may start dispensing; a slow
station -- lagging but not failed -- cannot observe or start until it recovers. A
station stops dispensing when done. A station can be marked slow and later recover.

Actions: pass the token and advance the epoch while nobody is dispensing, observe
the current epoch as the token holder, start dispensing when holding a fresh
token, stop dispensing, mark a station slow, and recover a slow station.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every station that is dispensing currently holds the token and
has observed the current authority epoch, so no unauthorized or stale station
ever performs a dispense.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m8p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Surgeons, Rooms
VARIABLES wing, room, operating, down

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ wing \in Surgeons \cup {None}
    /\ room \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {None}]
    /\ operating \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {None}]
    /\ down \subseteq Surgeons

Init ==
    /\ wing = None
    /\ room = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ operating = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ down = {}

AcquireWing(s) ==
    /\ wing = None
    /\ s \notin down
    /\ wing' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<room, operating, down>>

ReleaseWing(s) ==
    /\ wing = s
    /\ wing' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<room, operating, down>>

AcquireRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ wing = s
    /\ s \notin down
    /\ room[r] = None
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, operating, down>>

Operate(s, r) ==
    /\ room[r] = s
    /\ s \notin down
    /\ operating[r] = None
    /\ operating' = [operating EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, down>>

Leave(s, r) ==
    /\ operating[r] = s
    /\ operating' = [operating EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, down>>

ReleaseRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ room[r] = s
    /\ operating[r] # s
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, operating, down>>

Crash(s) ==
    /\ s \notin down
    /\ down' = down \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, operating>>

Reboot(s) ==
    /\ s \in down
    /\ down' = down \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, operating>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons : AcquireWing(s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons : ReleaseWing(s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons, r \in Rooms : AcquireRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons, r \in Rooms : Operate(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons, r \in Rooms : Leave(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons, r \in Rooms : ReleaseRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Crash(s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Reboot(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<wing, room, operating, down>>

MutexRoom == \A r \in Rooms : operating[r] # None => room[r] = operating[r]
=============================================================================
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler protects its operating rooms with a two-level
hierarchical lock: a single coarse wing lock, then a fine per-room lock. A surgeon
first acquires the coarse wing lock, and while holding it may acquire the fine
lock on a specific room. Only a surgeon holding a room's fine lock may operate in
that room, and only when no one else is operating there. A surgeon leaves the room
when finished and later releases the room's fine lock (once not operating). The
wing lock can be released at any time by its holder. Any surgeon can crash
silently, after which it cannot acquire locks or start operating; a crashed
surgeon can later reboot, and even a crashed holder's locks can be released.

Actions: acquire the wing lock, release the wing lock, acquire a room's fine lock,
operate in a room under its fine lock, leave a room, release a room's fine lock,
crash silently, and reboot.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any surgeon operating in a room holds that room's fine lock, so
at most one surgeon operates in any given operating room at a time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m3p2t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, Coordinators, Total, MaxTerm
VARIABLES float, till, online, leader, term

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ float \in 0..Total
    /\ till \in [Machines -> 0..Total]
    /\ online \subseteq Machines
    /\ leader \in Coordinators \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ float = Total
    /\ till = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ online = {}
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, till, online>>

Failover ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, till, online, term>>

BringOnline(m) ==
    /\ m \notin online
    /\ online' = online \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, till, leader, term>>

TakeOffline(m) ==
    /\ m \in online
    /\ till[m] = 0
    /\ online' = online \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, till, leader, term>>

Load(c, m) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ m \in online
    /\ float >= 1
    /\ float' = float - 1
    /\ till' = [till EXCEPT ![m] = till[m] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, leader, term>>

Unload(c, m) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ m \in online
    /\ till[m] >= 1
    /\ till' = [till EXCEPT ![m] = till[m] - 1]
    /\ float' = float + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, leader, term>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : Elect(c)
    \/ Failover
    \/ \E m \in Machines : BringOnline(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : TakeOffline(m)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators, m \in Machines : Load(c, m)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators, m \in Machines : Unload(c, m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<float, till, online, leader, term>>

TillTotal ==
    LET a == CHOOSE m \in Machines : TRUE
        b == CHOOSE m \in Machines : m # a
    IN till[a] + till[b]

Conservation == float + TillTotal = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2}
    Coordinators = {c1, c2}
    Total = 2
    MaxTerm = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A vending machine network keeps a fixed number of coin credits split between a
shared float and the individual machine tills. The network elects a coordinator
as leader to move credits, and supports failover: the current leader can fail,
after which a new leader is elected in a higher term. The network's capacity
changes at runtime: a machine can be brought online, and a machine can be taken
offline only once its till has been drained to zero. Only the leader may load a
credit from the shared float into an online machine's till, or unload a credit
from an online machine's till back into the float.

Actions: elect a leader when there is none, fail the leader over, bring a machine

a shared relay (the critical resource), with failover. Election messages travel
over an unreliable channel and can be reordered, so a candidate collects votes
into an unordered set in any order. When there is no leader and no candidate, a

enter the relay's critical section; it later exits. The leader may fail over and
step down only while the critical section is empty.

the leader over while the critical section is empty.

leader, so at most one drone controls the shared relay at any time.

acquires the coarse lock, then a fine lock on an active bin, and only then may

deallocated, freeing both views. The fine and coarse locks are released when done.

free, unlocked bin can be removed.

fine lock, add a bin, and remove a free bin.

that same prescription, so the two views stay consistent and no bin is ever
double allocated to two different prescriptions.

as a current instance, and finish processing.

equal to the current authority epoch, so no stale or unauthorized matching engine

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, slow>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ c \notin inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, slow>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ c \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, slow>>

Failover ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, inCS, slow>>

MarkSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inCS>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : Exit(c)
    \/ Failover
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : MarkSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leader, term, inCS, slow>>

Mutex == \A c \in inCS : leader = c

nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards a shared inventory register, which is a
critical resource, by electing a leader among coordinators with failover. When
there is no leader, a coordinator that is not slow is elected leader in a higher
term. Only the current leader, while not slow, may enter the critical section to
access the register, and it later exits. The leader may fail over and step down
only while the critical section is empty. A coordinator can be marked slow --
lagging but not failed -- and while slow it cannot be elected or enter the
critical section, until it recovers.

Actions: elect a leader when there is none, enter the critical section as the
leader, exit the critical section, fail the leader over while the critical section
is empty, mark a coordinator slow, and recover a slow coordinator.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every coordinator in the critical section is the current leader,
so at most one coordinator accesses the shared inventory register at a time.
